boundary: The packing advantage of the golden angle is real in continuous expanding spaces (phyllotaxis). It does not transfer to a discrete modular assignment of equal-sized items to a fixed device count, because that assignment is already exact in the uniform case and already has a correct optimal rule in the capacity-varied case.

tests.name: heterogeneous_fleet
tests.result: capacity-weighted dominant by ~2 orders on CV; golden-angle worse
